context: OpenSprinkler is an irrigation controller. Translate UI labels concisely and warnings accurately. A station controls a valve, not a transport station. Preserve placeholders and technical identifiers. Never infer controller data.

terms.Station: An irrigation output controlling a valve or a special target.
terms.Master Station: An output for a shared master valve or pump, operated with associated irrigation stations.
terms.Sequential Group: Stations in the same group normally run one after another.
terms.Bundle Station: A leader station that operates a configured set of member outputs together.
terms.Cycle and Soak: Divide watering into shorter cycles separated by time for water to soak into soil.
terms.Weather Adjustment: Adjust watering duration using weather conditions.
terms.Water Level: A watering-duration percentage, not the depth of water in a tank.
terms.Rain Delay: Temporarily suspend watering for a specified period.
terms.Hostname: A device network name, distinct from its display name.

zh.Maximum cycle (minutes): 每段最长浇水时间（分钟）

Bundle.note: A collection of irrigation outputs operated together, not a society or association. Provisional terminology awaiting native-speaker approval; avoid אגודה.
